method: Independent bounded model review of all 1345 selected English-source ordinary-profile finite senses and all 655 Apertium finite lexical pairs, read in manageable sequential batches. Examined selected source gloss/tags/context and representative rendered clauses; used Spanish linguistic knowledge conservatively for definition-free bilingual pairs. Keep means no identified subject-role/construction blocker in this audit, not fresh approval of every lexical nuance or translated-word coverage. Restrict proposes only the literal third-singular it subset where legitimate, excluding human/formal-you and imperatives; reasons explicitly request source evidence before restoring unestablished human figuratives. Human actors acting on animal/plant patients, ordinary human biological acts, genuinely human-compatible figuratives and conventional drivers/crews remain ordinary. Unsupported make-result patient slots and appearance-versus-visual-action frames are withheld. No personified weather or imagined animal speakers are used as justification. No new source attribution, examples or native-human certification is claimed. No app files changed; proposed restrictions require independent cross-review before integration.

restrict.reason: Selected spicy/stinging sense has food or drink as its subject; singular it is a safe literal subset, not a human speaker.
Selected intransitive abating refers to wind, weather or an intensity decreasing; it-only avoids importing the distinct human sail-reduction act.

Selected chorrear/trickle is literal flowing/dripping liquid; no human-agent or human-motion sense is established for this exact rendering.
Explicit lamb/goat hopping sense requires an animal subject; singular it is safe.
Literal confluir/flow-together is supported for water or similar entities; no independently supplied human figurative frame licenses unrestricted human subjects.

Selected pacer has livestock eating grass; do not turn it into a human farmer grazing cattle.

Selected pastear/graze has livestock feeding, not a person managing grazing animals.
Exact selected piar context is a bird making short cries; human/figurative reading requires separate source support.

Exact selected sparse-density reading has a material or group as subject; unrestricted singular human I become sparse is not supported.
Literal resonating sound/object is supported; a human emotional resonate-with reading needs exact source evidence and a different required context.
Literal retumbar/rumble has an emitting sound/object/body part as subject; no independently supplied human whole-person speech reading establishes unrestricted subjects.
Selected rielar is tremulous light shining; a literal singular luminous/reflecting entity is safe, whereas human figuratives need source confirmation.
This selected rugir frame is rumble, distinct from the independently human-capable bellow sense; literal noise-emitting entity is safe.
Selected literary sparkle/shine is literal light emission/reflection; human figurative excellence is not independently supplied for this exact sense.
Selected intransitive sonar/sound-ring is a sounding entity; unrestricted I sound requires a human voice/appearance complement or a different transitive action not established here.
Selected titilar/twinkle is literal intermittent light from an entity or eye; no source-attested whole-person figurative reading is supplied.
Exact selected source explicitly says of a horse and defines its gait; human trotting is a separate possible usage needing source support.
Literal abundar/abound supports an abundant substance/entity, not singular human I abound; human agreement/expansion uses would need separately sourced constructions.
Balar/bleat is supported as an animal call; preserve literal singular it, not unrestricted human subjects without exact figurative source evidence.
Desovar/spawn is an egg-laying animal as subject; do not import human/computing spawn figuratives without source evidence.
Literal fluir/flow is supported for a flowing entity; unrestricted human metaphor needs exact source evidence before preserving that subject profile.
Literal rebrotar/burgeon supports fresh plant growth or recurrence of an entity/outbreak; a whole-person human figurative mapping needs exact source evidence.
Resonar is literal reverberating sound; ordinary I echoed could mean repeating another speaker, which is not established for this exact Spanish pair.
Literal sonar/sound describes an emitting instrument/entity; an unrestricted human action or appearance reading needs precise transitive/performer source evidence.

Literal surgir/arise is supported for an emerging issue/event/entity; unrestricted I arise can instead mean getting up, not established by this pair. Request explicit human emergence evidence before restoring ordinary.
